districts.name: Hip-hop and designer sneakers
districts.blurb: Leans toward Travis Scott, Kendrick Lamar, SZA, Supreme, Nike and Gucci, and away from Taylor Swift and Lululemon.

districts.name: Fortnite, Afrobeats and streetwear
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Fortnite, Burna Boy, Travis Scott, Supreme, Gucci and Nike, while skipping Patagonia and Lululemon.

districts.name: Country, podcasts and athleisure
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on Morgan Wallen, Taylor Swift, Call Her Daddy, Joe Rogan, Lululemon and Patagonia, and away from Supreme.

districts.name: Global pop and football
districts.blurb: Leans toward Coldplay, Olivia Rodrigo, Burna Boy, Bad Bunny, Lionel Messi and Friends reruns, with less Fortnite.

districts.name: Pop divas and binge TV
districts.blurb: Over-indexes on The Office, Stranger Things, Drag Race, Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish and Beyoncé, and away from Burna Boy.
